name: Select
title: Select
description: A common form component for choosing a predefined value in a dropdown menu.

files.content: {#snippet content()} {#if props.children} {@render props.children()} {:else} {#each items as item} {item.label} {/each} {/if} {/snippet} {#if props.type === "multiple"} { value = next; props.onValueChange?.(next); }} > {@render content()} {:else} { value = next; props.onValueChange?.(next); }} > {@render content()} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Group>, "child">;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<SelectPrimitive.Group
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-group"
	class={cn("cn-select-group", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SelectPrimitive.Group>

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.GroupHeading>, "child">;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<SelectPrimitive.GroupHeading
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-group-label"
	class={cn("cn-select-group-label", className)}
	{...rest}

	{@render children?.()}
</SelectPrimitive.GroupHeading>

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Item>, "children" | "child"> & {
	children?: Snippet;
};
let { ref = $bindable(null), value, class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<SelectPrimitive.Item
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-item"
	class={cn("cn-select-item", className)}
	{value}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SelectPrimitive.Item>

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps, Snippet } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type PortalOptions = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Portal>, "children">;
type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Content>, "children" | "child"> & {
	portalProps?: PortalOptions;
	class?: string;
	children?: Snippet;
};

let {
	ref = $bindable(null),
	portalProps = {},
	class: className = "",
	children,
	...rest
}: Props = $props();
</script>

<SelectPrimitive.Portal {...portalProps}>
	<SelectPrimitive.Content bind:ref data-slot="select-popup" class={cn("cn-select-popup", className)} {...rest}>
		{@render children?.()}
	</SelectPrimitive.Content>
</SelectPrimitive.Portal>

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton>;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();
</script>

<SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-scroll-down-button"
	class={cn("cn-select-scroll-button", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SelectPrimitive.ScrollDownButton>

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton>;

let { ref = $bindable(null), class: className = "", children, ...rest }: Props = $props();

<SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-scroll-up-button"
	class={cn("cn-select-scroll-button", className)}
	{...rest}

</SelectPrimitive.ScrollUpButton>
{@render children?.()}

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
import type { ComponentProps } from "svelte";
import { cn } from "../utils.js";

type Props = Omit<ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Value>, "children" | "child"> & {
	class?: string;
	children?: ComponentProps<typeof SelectPrimitive.Value>["children"];
};

let {
	ref = $bindable(null),
	class: className = "",
	children: valueChildren = undefined,
	...rest
}: Props = $props();
</script>

{#if valueChildren}
	<SelectPrimitive.Value
		bind:ref
		data-slot="select-value"
		class={cn("cn-select-value", className)}
		{...rest}
	>
		{#snippet children(props)}
			{@render valueChildren?.(props)}
		{/snippet}
	</SelectPrimitive.Value>
{:else}
	<SelectPrimitive.Value
		bind:ref
		data-slot="select-value"
		class={cn("cn-select-value", className)}
		{...rest}
	/>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
import { Select as SelectPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

<SelectPrimitive.Viewport
	bind:ref
	data-slot="select-viewport"
	class={cn("cn-select-viewport", className)}
	{...rest}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SelectPrimitive.Viewport>
